comparison.objective: Align a loose splash-shield panel and body hole, then push a retainer through both; candidate removes tangs from already-installed inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: One hand maintains overlapping holes while the other performs straight clip insertion and seating versus mandrel stabilization plus impact and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Panel flat and aligned, clip upright with collar caught and head within 1 mm, stable for one second; no fracture or free-fragment recovery.
comparison.reason: Tests joining two layers with a push retainer, not breaking a sacrificial feature while preserving the surrounding insert.
